polaris: LP29-C2T / provenance-complete external joined table construction

framework.name: provenance-first same-sample external validation
framework.decision_rule: A row is usable for material validation only if every required_join_field is populated from auditable DOI/table/figure/SI/local-artifact provenance and all baseline, controls, graph features, and external labels refer to the same sample, structure, or explicitly declared snapshot/window.
framework.material_validation_gate: material_validation_allowed=true is forbidden unless at least one provenance-complete same-sample joined row exists.
framework.scope_boundary: C2T is an empirical validation prerequisite for C2, not a new material-mechanism claim.

findings.bottom_line: blocked: no provenance-complete same-sample joined rows were found in public literature, local A-side artifacts, or already extracted C2T artifacts.

srivastava_2019.title: Electronic structure and transport in amorphous metal oxide and amorphous metal oxynitride semiconductors
positive_evidence: MCP full-text read confirms the paper defines orbital-overlap integral from structural information and reports Table II pair-count, average-distance, OI, and pairs*OI/volume values for a-IGZO and a-ZnON rows.

Local A artifact C2_Srivastava_baseline_rows.csv contains four source rows with sample_id, source_row_id, DOI, material formula, cell_volume_m3, reported OI_norm, pair_cutoff_A=4, kernel description, and m_eff_over_m0.
blocking_evidence: structure_id is empty for the local baseline rows.
num_atoms is empty for the local baseline rows.
OI_raw_sum is empty and exact executable SI normalization is not reproduced.
No same-sample B0 onsite variance, carrier-density audit, mobility-edge margin, or G1 graph metrics are joined to these rows.
The m_eff values are internal calculated labels/baseline context, not an independent external graph-validation label.
srivastava_2019.verdict: Srivastava provides the nearest must-beat orbital-overlap baseline, but it does not provide a provenance-complete joined row for C2T.

jankousky_2025_2026.title: Effective bands and band-like electron transport in amorphous solids
positive_evidence: MCP metadata and full-text read confirm a first-principles a-In2O3 effective-band/transport framework with random-structure ensemble, QSGW subset, effective mass, spectral broadening, disorder-limited mobility, mean-free-path estimates, and SI figures.
The paper has structure-like ensemble provenance internally: 1500 random 40-atom structures and 100 QSGW structures are described.
blocking_evidence: The accessible text does not expose a row-level raw structure bundle with stable structure_id values ready for our graph construction.
No Srivastava-style O_s baseline is joined to the same structures.
No C2 G1 graph metrics are computed under the locked graph rule.
The reported transport/effective-band outputs are ensemble/model outputs, not a C2T row table with all required fields and forbidden-control audit.
jankousky_2025_2026.verdict: Jankousky is a strong candidate source for future rows if raw structures/SI and row-level labels can be extracted, but it is not provenance-complete for C2T Round 1.

furubayashi_2019.title: New Insights on Factors Limiting the Carrier Transport in Very Thin Amorphous Sn-Doped In2O3 Films with High Hall Mobility
positive_evidence: MCP CrossRef/PMC/EuropePMC search confirms an open record for a-ITO films with film thickness, mass density, Hall mobility, carrier-density/mean-free-path context, and transport-limiting factors.

Local A artifact A1_Furubayashi2019_digitized_transport_schema.csv defines candidate columns such as t_nm, rho_ohm_cm, n_H_cm3, mu_H_cm2_Vs, density_g_cm3, roughness_nm, tau_fs, l_Drude_nm, kF_l, and target_independence_status.
blocking_evidence: The local schema has no completed numeric per-sample row beyond F2019_TODO.
No stable same-sample structure_id or structure_or_SI_source is joined.
No Srivastava O_s baseline or G1 graph metrics are available for the same samples.
Hall mobility, carrier density, conductivity/resistivity require forbidden-control leakage audit before any label/control use.
furubayashi_2019.verdict: Furubayashi can supply candidate transport labels after digitization, but it cannot currently close any required C2T row.

jang_2022.title: Control of Carrier Concentrations in AOSs and Application to Bulk-Accumulation TFTs
positive_evidence: MCP CrossRef search confirms the AOS carrier-concentration chapter by Suhui Lee and Jin Jang.
The source is relevant to AOS carrier-density and TFT transport context.
blocking_evidence: MCP could not retrieve a readable PDF text for this DOI in this run.
No local A-side row-level numeric extraction, sample_id, structure_or_SI_source, Srivastava baseline, or G1 graph metrics are present.
No same-sample external label row can be assembled from the available evidence.
jang_2022.verdict: Jang remains candidate-only; it does not provide a provenance-complete C2T row in Round 1.

weakest_link.primary: structure_or_SI_source plus stable structure_id is missing for every candidate validation row.
secondary: Srivastava exact executable O_s normalization is not reproduced.
G1 graph features cannot be computed without auditable raw structures.
External transport/spectral labels are not joined to the same samples as baseline and graph features.
Forbidden-control audit cannot run because no complete row exists.
weakest_link.consequence: The current evidence can only support a blocked provenance table, not material validation.

next_plan: Reproduce Srivastava O_s exactly: obtain SI/formula details, implement the normalization, populate OI_raw_sum, and verify the four reported OI_norm values.
Create a row-to-structure crosswalk for Srivastava and/or Jankousky: structure_id, structure_or_SI_source, num_atoms/snapshot size, DOI/SI path, and versioned local file path.

Digitize Furubayashi rows only with table/figure point ids, units, measurement conditions, and target-independence status; do not use Hall-derived quantities as controls for Hall-mobility targets without audit.
For Jankousky, locate whether the Nature Physics article or associated repository exposes raw 40-atom structures or computed row-level spectral labels; if not, keep candidate_only.
For Jang, only promote from candidate_only after readable row-level numeric labels and structure/sample provenance are obtained.
Assemble a C2T blocked provenance table before attempting material validation; set material_validation_allowed=false for every incomplete row.
